title: False positive, false negative, true positive and true negative

videos.script: Every alarm makes two kinds of mistake. It rings when nothing is wrong. And it stays quiet when something is. {{two}} Security names them false positives and false negatives. Every detection you will ever write trades one against the other. {{trade}} In this lesson you will measure one. A week of sign-in attempts at the shop, with an authorised exercise hidden inside it, and a twenty-line detector that counts failures. {{week}} At one threshold it misses most of the exercise. At a lower one it catches nearly all of it, and drowns ana in alerts about a backup job. {{threshold}} Then the numbers that decide whether anybody will still read the alerts next month. {{fatigue}}
